rules.statement: A fraudulent minor who states he is of full age, is bound by his contract and the minor must be at the time of the contract held to have been a major in the eye of the law.
rules.supporting_quote: "Even regarding this action as a merely vindicatory one, a fraudulent minor who states he is of full age, is bound by his contract, and the minor must be at the time of the contract held to have been a major in the eye of the law ( juris interpretation)."
